title: How to batch a week of content in 90 minutes
caption:
Posting every day is hard when you start from a blank screen every day.

Batching fixes it: collect ideas all week, write in one focused session, review, schedule, done.

Here is the 90-minute routine.

steps.title: Collect (15 min)
steps.desc: Pull the week's ideas from your notes, comments and DMs.

steps.title: Draft (45 min)
steps.desc: Write every post in one go. **Don't edit while drafting.**

steps.title: Review (15 min)
steps.desc: Read each post out loud. Cut anything that doesn't sound like you.

steps.title: Schedule (15 min)
steps.desc: Queue them into your best time slots and close the laptop.

bullets: **Saves and shares**: a stronger signal than likes
**Replies and DMs**: real conversations with your audience
**Best pillar**: which theme your audience responds to most
slides.note: Review once a month. Do more of what works.

slides.text: A good post every day beats a perfect post every month.
